shared_elements: linear incised/carved motifs on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry carved/marked figural imagery including schematic humanoid forms, but A shows outline-drawn ships with crew strokes, cup-marks and small stick figures scattered freely over an open rock face, while B shows a densely packed vertical stela with a large frontal richly costumed figure surrounded by framed panels of block-like signs. The manner of depiction (thin linear outline versus deep three-dimensional relief with modelled bodies and ornament) and the compositional logic (dispersed versus register-organised and framed) share nothing specific.
